title: Bearframe runtime terrain tilesheet geometry
summary: World Editor v1 runtime tilesheets are 384 by 768 pixels using an 8 by 16 grid of 48 by 48 pixel tiles. Use top-left origin, exactly 128 slots, RGBA PNG, clean transparency, and no labels, gaps, or resizing. Preserve stable tile IDs and order.
source: Founder-defined Bearframe World Editor v1 production standard
